scope: Source and saved geometry only; no actual assembly, FK, force solve, physics or training qualification.

source_material_contract.phone_frame: Original phone BODY coordinates, meters, outward normals. Never substitute inertial axes, geom compiler frame, a reflected hand, or a rescaled object.
source_material_contract.exact_branch: Keep original ego-derived convex-projected point bytes and the named actual phone triangle/normal. Thumb source triangle367; index source triangle6. Proximity is not a measured contact or force label.
source_material_contract.region_branch: Only the separately named preregistered1mm branch: enumerate all real filled phone triangles whose closest point lies inside the algorithmic1mm ball. Keep all finite candidates and the predeclared normal-angle/distance/ID rank. This radius is not a measured uncertainty or confidence interval.
source_material_contract.normal_contract: Retain the actual source triangle outward normal and explicit frame. At edges or vertices the selected face normal is a named conditional choice, not a unique physical contact normal or an averaged replacement.
source_material_contract.hand_contract: Both branches retain original307 hand triangles2332/1876, vertex order, filled-triangle projected points, barycentrics and geom-local outward normals. Functional pad/pressure area UNKNOWN.
source_material_contract.kinematics_contract: Hand points/normals move with their real geom transforms; phone points/normals move with the proper phone SE3. For assembly use point closure and tangent normal equations plus the opposed-normal branch, not only positional proximity.
source_material_contract.lineage_contract: Carry source artifact hash, branch name, triangle and vertex IDs, barycentrics, original ego target, chosen material point, displacement, source-normal difference, boundary distances and original scan-proximity semantics into every subsequent record. New anchor schemas require a new guarded consumer route; do not bypass or edit the frozen307-only K interface.

The1mm thumb choice is at a triangle edge; a selected one-face normal is not a unique native contact normal. Keep boundary status and eventual whole native manifold.
